$ qm "link-branch" "legacy" "feat/new"
exit 0
--- stdout
legacy → feat/old, feat/new
--- legacy.md
---
v: 1
title: Legacy
state: in_progress
project: No project

- worktree-a
- worktree-b
pf_mode: dev

- at: 'TS'
  from: s0
  via: wrap
  carried:
  - 1
  - 2
  decisions: 1
  open: 0
snoozed_until: 'DATE'
branches:
- feat/old
- feat/new
---
